events.title: The Forging of the World-Spire & First Iron-Oak
events.description: Aureon and Sylvara bind the primordial elemental chaos beneath the Shattered Coast and plant the colossal Iron-Oak at the heart of what will become Oakhaven.

events.title: The First Dragon Concord of the Ironpeaks
events.description: Ancient metallic and chromatic wyrms carve out the northern mountain vaults before retreating into centuries-long slumber.

events.title: The Night of Falling Stars & Sinking of Old Oakhaven
events.description: A catastrophic planar rift tears open above the coast. Half of Old Oakhaven collapses beneath the sea, creating the flooded Sunken Ward and submerging the royal catacombs.

events.title: Sealing of the Obsidian Sanctum
events.description: Archmages and Dawn-Paladins lock the Shadowfell breach beneath the catacombs using the Obsidian Key, swearing an oath to guard the seal forever.

events.title: Founding of the Cinder-Forge & Silver Bastion
events.description: Dwarven smith-clans ignite the great blast furnaces of the Cinder-Forge while the Order of the Silver Gauntlet raises the white marble walls of Highspire.

events.title: The Grand Exchange Charter & Rise of the Syndicate
events.description: The Gilded Scales Consortium secures monopoly rights over maritime trade, inadvertently driving independent captains into the arms of the Obsidian Syndicate.

events.title: The Adventuring Party Convenes at the Rusted Anchor
events.description: Our heroes gather in Oakhaven as tensions boil over between the Silver Gauntlet, the striking Ironbound dockworkers, and whispers of a Pale Moon ritual in the catacombs.

events.title: Quest Completed: The Drowned Bell of St. Jude
events.description: Recover the consecrated silver bell sunken in the flooded catacombs before cultists defile it with necromantic ichor.

events.description: Clear out the goblin raiders ambushing flour wagons along the north highway.

events.title: Session Chronicle Recap — Day 1
events.description:
# 🛡️ Campaign Chronicle: Session Recap — Day 1
**Campaign**: Default Campaign • **Date**: Day 1, 11:00 (Autumn • Overcast & Gloomy, Mild & Pleasant)

## 👥 Adventuring Party Vitals
- **Thorne Ironbreaker** (Fighter (Battle Master), Lv 5): 44/44 HP
- **Lyra Moonwhisper** (Wizard (Evoker), Lv 5): 28/28 HP
- **Finnian Quickfoot** (Rogue (Thief), Lv 5): 12/33 HP
- **Sister Andrea** (Cleric (Life Domain), Lv 5): 38/38 HP

## ⚔️ Combat & Tactical Engagements
- **Combat State**: Active Combat (Round 1)
- **Adversaries Engaged**: Adult Green Dragon, Aboleth

## 📜 Quests & Milestones
### Completed:
- **The Drowned Bell of St. Jude** (The Sunken Ward Catacombs): Recover the consecrated silver bell sunken in the flooded catacombs before cultists defile it with necromantic ichor.
- **Bounty: Gnasher the Bone-Splitter** (Ironpeak Citadel Outskirts): Clear out the goblin raiders ambushing flour wagons along the north highway.
### Ongoing Quests:
- **Intercepting the Red-Wax Manifest** (2/4 objectives complete): Acquire the ledger detailing the Syndicate's corrupt harbor contacts before it is handed off at midnight.
- **Sabotage at Forge #4** (0/3 objectives complete): Investigate why the grand blast furnace has been misfiring and threatening to explode the ironworks.

## ⏳ Factions & Schemes
- **The Obsidian Syndicate**: Arcane Vault Infiltration: 3/6 ticks, Black Market Shipment Arrival: 2/4 ticks
- **Order of the Silver Gauntlet**: Martial Sweep of the Sunken Ward: 5/6 ticks
- **The Gilded Scales Consortium**: Buyout of Ironbound Foundries: 3/4 ticks
- **Circle of the Pale Moon**: Shadowfell Eclipse Awakening Ritual: 6/8 ticks
- **The Ironbound Union**: General Dockworkers Strike: 3/4 ticks

## 🔍 Discovered Secrets & Lore
- No new clues discovered this session.

## 📝 Session Notes & Highlights
- [QUEST] Party accepted contract from Guildmaster Vance to inspect the Sunken Ward warehouse.
- [CLUE] Found a stamped brass coin marked with the Obsidian Syndicate cipher beneath a loose flagstone.
- [LOOT] Finnian bought 2x Potions of Healing (100 gp total) from the apothecary at Oakhaven Market.
